_: Which group each animal belongs to on the Builder's 'Who is in it?' step (server/builder/plan.js): the animals of the 3D worlds (Kit 2 themes) and the 2D sprite animals (the 2D art packs). scripts/build-kit2-rules.js writes this list into the catalogue (server/builder/kit2-catalog.js). For a 3D animal a theme manifest's own creature.group wins, then this list, then its kind (a water animal is 'sea', any other is 'wild'); for a 2D sprite this list, then its pack group ('dinosaur' is 'dinosaurs'), then 'wild'. A group with no animal in either catalogue shows as 'Coming soon' and lights up by itself when one ships. Add a line here when a theme or a 2D pack ships a new animal.
